title: He Turned Around On Camera Six

scenes.subtext: After a month with his back to me.
scenes.narration: Tonight the man on camera six turned around. After a month with his back to the lens, he looked up at it.

scenes.text: THE LENS FLARES WHERE HIS FACE IS
scenes.subtext: Like a torch into the glass.
scenes.narration: His face is not there. The lens flares where it should be, the way it does when somebody shines a torch into it.

scenes.narration: I carry a torch. It is the only one in the building. On the recording, he is holding it up.

scenes.text: I SWITCHED MINE ON. HIS GOT BRIGHTER.
scenes.narration: I have just switched mine on to check it. On camera six, the flare got brighter.
